name: futsal-match-analyzer
description: Evidence-based visual review of futsal events from local MP4 recordings.

interface.longDescription: Analyze a local MP4 futsal recording with agent-assisted visual review. Inspect timestamped frame grids, verify candidate events, export evidence clips, and save JSON, CSV and Markdown reports with explicit sampled-review coverage. Runs locally using Python and FFmpeg; no model API key is required. The host assistant interprets the images; this is not a standalone automatic event detector.
defaultPrompt: Analyze the futsal match recording at this local MP4 path and produce a timestamped event report.
